preregistration.revision_reason: before execution, adversarial review required byte-exact negative sampling, reducer-order separation, locked intermediate population digests, nested disposition expectations, and validation of canonical frame IDs and structural values

hypothesis: All publisher-labeled same-event and deterministically sampled different-event pairs collapse to one non-discriminating structural basis after Netbraid normalization, so the structural v0 reducer selects unknown for every weighted pair.

normalization.label_join: observer plus exact Frame_number equals packet frame.number

positive_population.canonical_pair_id: ASCII {lower_observer}:{lower_frame_decimal}|{higher_observer}:{higher_frame_decimal}, with no leading zeroes in frame numbers
positive_population.population_digest_encoding: SHA-256 of canonical pair IDs sorted by UTF-8 byte order, each followed by one LF byte

negative_population.conditioning: oracle-conditioned only to reject equal event keys after candidate construction; oracle values never affect ordering, offset, rank, reducer ordering, or the decision basis
negative_population.candidate_construction: for each lexicographic observer pair, sort both sides by ascending Frame_number; for k in [0, min(left_count, right_count)), pair left[k] with right[(k + offset) % right_count]
negative_population.offset_preimage: UTF-8 bytes netbraid.sorbonne-negative-offset.v0, NUL, campaign_id, NUL, lower_observer, NUL, higher_observer
negative_population.offset: interpret the first eight SHA-256 digest bytes as an unsigned big-endian integer, then take value % right_count
negative_population.canonical_pair_id: ASCII {lower_observer}:{lower_frame_decimal}|{higher_observer}:{higher_frame_decimal}, with no leading zeroes in frame numbers
negative_population.rank_preimage: UTF-8 bytes netbraid.sorbonne-negative-rank.v0, NUL, campaign_id, NUL, canonical_pair_id
negative_population.selection: reject equal oracle event keys, assert candidate IDs are unique and disjoint from positives, sort by (raw 32-byte rank digest, canonical_pair_id UTF-8 bytes), then take the first expected_count
negative_population.population_digest_encoding: SHA-256 of canonical pair IDs sorted by UTF-8 byte order, each followed by one LF byte

pairs.sampling_identity_order: observer then frame order from canonical_pair_id
pairs.reducer_input_order: independently canonicalize by capture_id, record_id, then envelope_sha256 exactly as assess_packet_same_event_v0
pairs.representative_reduction: group each labeled population by reducer-equivalent eligibility outcome plus the exact ordered structural basis; run the Rust reducer on the lexicographically first canonical_pair_id per label and group; group output classes by schema, reducer, basis, dispositions, reference, and limitations while excluding audit-only evidence references; apply the group count as weight

primary: weighted disposition counts by oracle label
distinct structural pair-basis count by oracle label
diagnostic: normalized packet and quarantine counts by observer
metrics.classification_accuracy: not_reported because abstention is an explicit retained outcome and the campaign is a capability boundary audit

failure_gates: archive identity or selected member inventory differs
normalization is partial, quarantined, or not bijective with publisher labels
pair population counts, uniqueness, disjointness, or registered digests differ
any reducer assessment uses a basis outside the closed allowlist
observed weighted dispositions or basis counts differ from expected_results
two executions with equal archive bytes, Netbraid and reducer executable bytes, TShark version and effective configuration digest, field registry, and limits produce different canonical report bytes

interpretation.if_confirmed: This Sorbonne run validates the abstention boundary and pipeline wiring but cannot estimate same-event discrimination; a richer corpus is required.
interpretation.if_falsified: Stop and inspect normalization, label joins, or newly varying structural evidence before changing the reducer or campaign.

limitations: publisher keys label event correspondence and condition negative rejection but are never decision-basis inputs; audit-only envelope digests bind full normalized records
the prior oracle audit already established constant publisher invariant metadata, so this is a confirmatory contract campaign rather than a discovery claim
deterministic negative sampling measures this registered population only
source authenticity and annotation correctness are not independently established
